content.json: *Tier 1 — Cost & Reliability lives on the Cost + Health workbook, not here.*

# Tier 0 — Answer first

Is AI quality good right now? One row per question, evaluated live below. **Kind** says whether a number is *counted* (HARD — a real confusion matrix or gate) or *an LLM judging an LLM* (SOFT — 0-1 scale, not ground truth, useful for trend, not for a hard verdict). Golden-bank (fixed 35-case script) and live-traffic (real production turns) use **different score bands** and are never averaged together — see `Golden-bank pass rate` (Section D) and `Live-traffic pass rate` (Section G) below for why.

content.query:
let latest_extraction =
    AppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | where Name == "extraction_benchmark_run"
    | extend d = parse_json(Properties)
    | extend alert_recall_pct = todouble(d.alert_recall_pct), clean_false_positive_rate_pct = todouble(d.clean_false_positive_rate_pct)
    | summarize (latest_ts, alert_recall_pct, clean_false_positive_rate_pct) = arg_max(TimeGenerated, alert_recall_pct, clean_false_positive_rate_pct);
let row1 =
    latest_extraction
    | extend
        recall_status = case(isnull(alert_recall_pct), "blue", alert_recall_pct < 80, "red", alert_recall_pct < 100, "yellow", "green"),
        fp_status = case(isnull(clean_false_positive_rate_pct), "blue", clean_false_positive_rate_pct >= 20, "red", clean_false_positive_rate_pct > 0, "yellow", "green")
    | extend Status = case(recall_status == "red" or fp_status == "red", "red", recall_status == "yellow" or fp_status == "yellow", "yellow", recall_status == "blue" and fp_status == "blue", "blue", "green")
    | project
        Rank = 1,
        Metric = "Extraction — measured",
        Kind = "HARD — counted",
        Value = strcat("recall ", iff(isnull(alert_recall_pct), "n/a", strcat(tostring(round(alert_recall_pct,1)), "%")), " / FP ", iff(isnull(clean_false_positive_rate_pct), "n/a", strcat(tostring(round(clean_false_positive_rate_pct,1)), "%"))),
        Status,
        Detail = "from e1's recall (red<80%/yellow<100%, 80% never reads green) + clean false-positive rate (red>=20%/yellow>0%)";
let latest_golden =
    AppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | where Name == "agent_eval_summary"
    | extend d = parse_json(Properties)
    | extend run_label = tostring(d.run_label), pass_rate = todouble(d.pass_rate), faithfulness_mean = todouble(d.faithfulness_mean), relevance_mean = todouble(d.relevance_mean), context_mean = todouble(d.context_mean), orchestration_mean = todouble(d.orchestration_mean)
    | where run_label in ("nightly", "predeploy")
    | summarize (latest_ts, pass_rate, faithfulness_mean, relevance_mean, context_mean, orchestration_mean) = arg_max(TimeGenerated, pass_rate, faithfulness_mean, relevance_mean, context_mean, orchestration_mean);
let row2 =
    latest_golden
    | extend Status = case(isnull(pass_rate), "blue", pass_rate < 0.60, "red", pass_rate < 0.75, "yellow", "green")
    | project
        Rank = 2,
        Metric = "Chat — measured (golden-bank pass rate)",
        Kind = "HARD — counted",
        Value = iff(isnull(pass_rate), "n/a", tostring(round(pass_rate, 4))),
        Status,
        Detail = "from d1 — 35 fixed cases, conjunctive gate, bands red<0.60/yellow<0.75 (see Golden-bank pass rate above)";
let row3 =
    latest_golden
    | extend soft_vals = pack_array(faithfulness_mean, relevance_mean, context_mean, orchestration_mean)
    | mv-expand soft_val = soft_vals to typeof(double)
    | summarize offline_soft_mean = avg(soft_val)
    | project
        Rank = 3,
        Metric = "Chat — judged, offline",
        Kind = "SOFT — LLM judge, 0-1, not ground truth",
        Value = iff(isnull(offline_soft_mean), "n/a", tostring(round(offline_soft_mean, 4))),
        Status = "blue",
        Detail = "informational mean of faithfulness/relevance/context/orchestration (D2/D3) — accuracy excluded (accuracy is HARD, graded vs. a known-correct reference); not itself banded, see each dimension's own band above";
let latest_prod =
    AppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Name == "agent_eval_run"
    | extend d = parse_json(Properties)
    | extend run_source = tostring(d.run_source), faithfulness_score = todouble(d.faithfulness_score), relevance_score = todouble(d.relevance_score), helpfulness_score = todouble(d.helpfulness_score), completeness_score = todouble(d.completeness_score), tone_score = todouble(d.tone_score)
    | extend run_source = iff(isempty(run_source), "production", run_source)
    | where run_source == "production"
    | summarize turns = count(), faithfulness = avg(faithfulness_score), relevance = avg(relevance_score), helpfulness = avg(helpfulness_score), completeness = avg(completeness_score), tone = avg(tone_score);
let row4 =
    latest_prod
    | extend live_vals = pack_array(faithfulness, relevance, helpfulness, completeness, tone)
    | mv-expand live_val = live_vals to typeof(double)
    | summarize live_soft_mean = avg(live_val), turns = max(turns)
    | project
        Rank = 4,
        Metric = "Chat — judged, live",
        Kind = "SOFT — LLM judge, 0-1, not ground truth",
        Value = iff(isnull(live_soft_mean), "n/a", tostring(round(live_soft_mean, 4))),
        Status = "blue",
        Detail = strcat("informational mean of faithfulness/relevance/helpfulness/completeness/tone over ", turns, " production turns (30d, G2) — accuracy/context excluded (NULL by construction, judge_mode=combined); uncolored by design, small sample");
let gap_rows =
    AppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Name == "ops_recommendation"
    | extend d = parse_json(Properties)
    | extend run_ts = todatetime(tostring(d.generated_at))
    | where tostring(d["category"]) == "ai_improvement";
let latest_gap_ts = toscalar(gap_rows | summarize max(run_ts));
let gap_candidates =
    gap_rows
    | where run_ts == latest_gap_ts
    | extend findings_raw = parse_json(tostring(d.findings))
    | mv-expand findings_raw
    | extend Field = tostring(findings_raw.field), Severity = tostring(findings_raw.severity), FDetail = tostring(findings_raw.detail)
    | where isnotempty(Severity) and Field != "(omitted)"
    | extend SeverityRank = case(Severity == "red", 0, Severity == "yellow", 1, 2)
    | order by SeverityRank asc, Field asc
    | take 1;
let gap_found = toscalar(gap_candidates | count | project Count);
let row5 =
    gap_candidates
    | project
        Rank = 5,
        Metric = strcat("Biggest gap — ", Field),
        Kind = "(see Where to focus table below for top 5)",
        Value = Severity,
        Status = Severity,
        Detail = FDetail
    | union (
        print Rank = 5, Metric = "Biggest gap", Kind = "(see Where to focus table below for top 5)", Value = "none", Status = "green", Detail = "latest ai_improvement pass had no red/yellow findings"
        | where gap_found == 0
    );
let row6 = print Rank = 6, Metric = "Cost & reliability", Kind = "(see Cost + Health workbook)", Value = "-> Cost + Health workbook", Status = "blue", Detail = "not duplicated here — container health, spend by service, budget burn live on the Cost + Health workbook (Monitor > Workbooks)";
row1
| union row2, row3, row4, row5, row6
| order by Rank asc
| project-away Rank
content.title: Tier 0 scorecard — is AI quality good right now? 6 rows: extraction (HARD), chat measured (HARD), chat judged offline/live (SOFT), biggest gap, and a pointer to Cost & reliability.

content.json: ## Tier 2 — Extraction & Chat Quality (second priority) — *both are already good; this tier exists to catch regressions and keep improving them, not to prove they work.*

### Chat quality — nightly test (golden bank) — *pass rate, all six soft scores (faithfulness, relevance, accuracy, context, orchestration, persona), cost per turn, response time. Score bands were recalibrated; see Section D below for the reasoning.*

## Section D — Nightly Test Quality (Golden bank) — *from `agent_eval_summary`, `run_label in ("nightly", "predeploy")`. `d1-latest-pass-rate` and `d2-accuracy` bands are red<0.60/yellow<0.75 and red<0.75/yellow<0.90 respectively (mirrors `services/ops_recommendation.py::SCORE_BANDS`), tuned to what "good" means rather than to historical scores. `d1` has no minimum-run guard: the golden bank is a fixed, deterministic, exhaustive 35-case script set with no sampling error to protect against. `d2`-`d4` still require a minimum run count.*

content.query:
let runs = AppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | where Name == "agent_eval_summary"
    | extend d = parse_json(Properties)
    | extend run_label = tostring(d.run_label), pass_rate = todouble(d.pass_rate)
    | where run_label in ("nightly", "predeploy");
let run_count = toscalar(runs | count | project Count);
runs
| summarize (latest_ts, latest_label, pass_rate) = arg_max(TimeGenerated, run_label, pass_rate)
| extend total = run_count
| project
    Metric = "golden bank — latest pass rate",
    Kind = "HARD — counted",
    Value = iff(isnull(pass_rate), real(null), round(pass_rate, 4)),
    Scale = "0-1 pass rate; red<0.60 / yellow<0.75 / green>=0.75 — this band applies to THIS panel only, not G1's live-traffic pass rate",
    Detail = strcat(total, " runs (nightly/predeploy), latest ", iff(isnull(pass_rate), "n/a", tostring(round(pass_rate,4))), " (", latest_label, ") — n=3-run guard removed (Fix 11, Gap 322): a fixed, deterministic, exhaustive 35-case script has no sampling error for that guard to protect against")
content.title: Golden-bank pass rate (35 fixed cases) — HARD, measured (conjunctive gate) — bands red<0.60/yellow<0.75, n=3-run guard removed. NOT the same band as G1's live-traffic pass rate.

content.json: ### Chat quality — real usage (production judge) — *from `agent_eval_run` where `run_source == "production"`. Separate pass rate from the golden bank's D1, never averaged together — they answer different questions (a fixed question set vs. real live traffic).*

## Section G — Real Usage (Production quality judge) — *from `agent_eval_run` where `run_source == "production"`, `judge_mode=combined`. **Live and populated**, not empty — the production online judge has scored real live turns; see `g1-turns-judged` above for the current 30d count. G1's pass rate is a **separate** row from D1's golden-bank pass rate — with **different color bands** (G1: red<0.20/yellow<0.30; D1: red<0.60/yellow<0.75) — never averaged together, they answer different questions (a fixed 35-case script vs. real live traffic; see the Tier-0 scorecard at the top). G2's `accuracy`/`context` rows are expected to stay at 0 scored turns by construction: `judge_mode=combined` never scores those two dimensions, and `pass` on a production row is faithfulness+relevance only.*

    | where run_source == "production";

    Detail = iff(total < 20, strcat("only ", total, " turns — below minimum n=20, ", passed, "/", total, " passed"), strcat(passed, "/", total, " passed"))
content.title: Live-traffic pass rate (real turns, different band) — HARD, measured — bands red<0.20/yellow<0.30. Separate from D1's golden-bank pass rate (red<0.60/yellow<0.75), never averaged together — that recalibration was explicitly scoped to D1 only.

content.query:
let turns = AppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Name == "agent_eval_run"
    | extend d = parse_json(Properties)
    | extend
        run_source = tostring(d.run_source),
        faithfulness_score = todouble(d.faithfulness_score),
        relevance_score = todouble(d.relevance_score),
        accuracy_score = todouble(d.accuracy_score),
        context_score = todouble(d.context_score),
        helpfulness_score = todouble(d.helpfulness_score),
        completeness_score = todouble(d.completeness_score),
        tone_score = todouble(d.tone_score)
    | extend run_source = iff(isempty(run_source), "production", run_source)
    | where run_source == "production";
turns
| summarize
    turns = count(),
    faithfulness = avg(faithfulness_score), faithfulness_n = countif(isnotnull(faithfulness_score)),
    relevance = avg(relevance_score), relevance_n = countif(isnotnull(relevance_score)),
    accuracy = avg(accuracy_score), accuracy_n = countif(isnotnull(accuracy_score)),
    context = avg(context_score), context_n = countif(isnotnull(context_score)),
    helpfulness = avg(helpfulness_score), helpfulness_n = countif(isnotnull(helpfulness_score)),
    completeness = avg(completeness_score), completeness_n = countif(isnotnull(completeness_score)),
    tone = avg(tone_score), tone_n = countif(isnotnull(tone_score))
| extend
    faithfulness = iff(isnan(faithfulness), real(null), faithfulness),
    relevance = iff(isnan(relevance), real(null), relevance),
    accuracy = iff(isnan(accuracy), real(null), accuracy),
    context = iff(isnan(context), real(null), context),
    helpfulness = iff(isnan(helpfulness), real(null), helpfulness),
    completeness = iff(isnan(completeness), real(null), completeness),
    tone = iff(isnan(tone), real(null), tone)
